source: 20261120 Text Inference Engine Component Atlas: edition.json capsuleMap and kinds, memory/runtime/factory.json titles. Muse Run 2 owner decision 002 maps state.prefix_store to kv_reuse_lab. Keys are capsule directories relative to factory/ccs (stable ids). atlas_cc_id is null for unmapped capsules.

builder.label: Builder
builder.plain: Writes the source code for one engine component. The CC is the method that builds the code; it is not the component itself.

tool.label: Tool
tool.plain: Runs an existing tool, lab or runner and returns a verified receipt or artifact. It does not write product source.

analysis.label: Analysis
analysis.plain: Reads evidence such as traces, counters and profiles and returns findings that a verifier can recompute. It does not write product source.

factory.label: Factory worker
factory.naming: Named for the factory job and its handoff
factory.plain: Performs one step of the software factory (brief, contract, work orders, integration, image or verdict) and hands off its artifact.

batch_layout_mapper.title: Batch layout mapper builder
batch_layout_mapper.summary: Maps uncached prompt rows to logical submissions that fill the physical microbatches.

branch_workbench.title: Hypothesis branch recorder
branch_workbench.summary: Records alternative hypotheses, reservations, evidence and pruning in the task graph.

builder.title: Image assembler
builder.summary: Turns a pinned, clean engine revision into an identified runtime image with a build receipt.

cache_size_pareto.title: MoE cache size tuner
cache_size_pareto.summary: Compares native MoE cache sizes per prompt length and recommends a cache setting.

cc_qualification.title: CC admission qualifier
cc_qualification.summary: Inspects CC release identity, checks verification units and assesses admission.

cc_workflow_lab.title: CC workflow receipt analysis
cc_workflow_lab.summary: Summarizes CC invocation receipts and designs workflow fixtures.

deep_profile.title: Engine profile analysis
deep_profile.summary: Parses prompt counters, native profiles or Nsight CSV into bounded evidence.

engine_factory_loop.title: Experiment loop orchestrator
engine_factory_loop.summary: Reserves, submits, recovers and collects an admitted experiment for a selected hypothesis.

engine_inspector.title: Engine inspector
engine_inspector.summary: Inspects an authorized source checkout, host and image and publishes the evidence.

evidence.title: Evidence publisher
evidence.summary: Finds and publishes task-scoped evidence, reports and decisions.

evidence_digest_lab.title: Evidence digest projector
evidence_digest_lab.summary: Returns exact JSON-pointer selections from evidence with source hashes.

expert_cache_lab.title: Expert cache prediction analysis
expert_cache_lab.summary: Evaluates causal next-expert predictions with prefix holdout.

expert_demand_predictor.title: Expert demand predictor builder
expert_demand_predictor.summary: Read-ahead hints for the next MoE layer, learned from completed router selections.

expert_prediction.title: Expert prediction holdout analysis
expert_prediction.summary: Evaluates an expert trace against frequency and last-token baselines.

expert_prefetch_readiness.title: Expert prefetch readiness analysis
expert_prefetch_readiness.summary: Summarizes issued versus useful expert prefetches against matched native controls.

expert_scale_wiring.title: Expert scale wiring builder
expert_scale_wiring.summary: Applies the per-expert NVFP4 global scales in the Muse mixture-of-experts block; packs without scales are unchanged.

expert_streaming.title: Expert streaming builder
expert_streaming.summary: Preserved historical llama.cpp expert-streaming patches with their build and lab tools.

expert_streaming/components/expert_fill.title: Expert fill builder
expert_streaming/components/expert_fill.summary: Historical patch: background workers that fill expert weights ahead of use.

expert_streaming/components/expert_prega.title: Expert pre-gate builder
expert_streaming/components/expert_prega.summary: Historical patch: gates expert compute until its fill is scheduled and observed.

expert_streaming/components/expert_readi.title: Expert readiness builder
expert_streaming/components/expert_readi.summary: Historical patch: readiness tracking for filled experts.

expert_streaming/components/inflight_joi.title: In-flight fill join builder
expert_streaming/components/inflight_joi.summary: Historical patch: joins a request to an expert fill that is already in flight.

expert_streaming/components/mmap_advice.title: Mmap advice builder
expert_streaming/components/mmap_advice.summary: Historical patch: random-access madvise for the mapped checkpoint.

expert_streaming/components/phase_stats.title: Phase statistics builder
expert_streaming/components/phase_stats.summary: Historical patch: per-phase resource usage counters for expert streaming.

expert_streaming/components/router_prefe.title: Router prefetch builder
expert_streaming/components/router_prefe.summary: Historical patch: prefetches expert pages selected by the router.

expert_streaming/components/thread_names.title: Expert fill thread names builder
expert_streaming/components/thread_names.summary: Historical patch: names the expert-fill worker threads; observability only.

expert_weight_cache.title: Expert weight cache builder
expert_weight_cache.summary: Bounded reuse of staged expert weight slices, so repeated expert copies are served from a cache.

expert_weight_residency.title: Expert weight residency builder
expert_weight_residency.summary: Residency planning code for expert weights, certified on CPU fixtures only.

expert_weight_streaming.title: Expert weight streaming builder
expert_weight_streaming.summary: Expert byte-range streaming code at the upstream source seam, certified on CPU fixtures only.

gpu_kernel_lab.title: GPU expert kernel analysis
gpu_kernel_lab.summary: Compares batched expert matrix-vector output with an FP64 CPU reference.

heterogeneous_placement_lab.title: Heterogeneous placement analysis
heterogeneous_placement_lab.summary: Estimates dependent transfers and compute for a CPU and GPU placement.

inference_lab.title: Inference experiment analysis
inference_lab.summary: Analyzes retained experiment reports across inference subsystems.

integration_skill.title: Engine integration runner
integration_skill.summary: Carries an integration job through preflight, build and lab with task-scoped evidence.

kv_reuse_lab.title: Prefix reuse analysis
kv_reuse_lab.summary: Turns on the engine's built-in prompt cache for document follow-up workloads.

lab_client.title: Capped lab runner
lab_client.summary: Submits one lab attempt for an identified image under the memory and CPU cap and returns its receipt.

lab_lifecycle.title: Lab attempt reconciler
lab_lifecycle.summary: Reads ownership and queue receipts and recovers terminal lab attempts.

lab_manager.title: Lab manager
lab_manager.summary: Seals a result under test, a lab task and the pinned contract into a lab package, sends it to a lab agent, relays questions and records the checked report.

memory_residency_lab.title: Memory residency analysis
memory_residency_lab.summary: Plans aligned arena offsets from liveness intervals.

methodology_ab.title: A/B experiment method
methodology_ab.summary: Counterbalanced A/B procedure for growing an engine one component at a time.

methodology_ablation.title: Ablation designer
methodology_ablation.summary: Designs one-variable diagnostic or ABBA work without executing it.

methodology_diagnosis.title: Experiment diagnosis analysis
methodology_diagnosis.summary: Surfaces uncertainties and inspection candidates from retained reports.

methodology_followup.title: Follow-up proposer
methodology_followup.summary: Turns report-backed uncertainty into a proposed next experiment input.

methodology_hypothesis.title: Hypothesis recorder
methodology_hypothesis.summary: Records an agent-authored, unmeasured hypothesis linked to scoped evidence.

methodology_out_of_core.title: Out-of-core cache protocol analysis
methodology_out_of_core.summary: Describes a bounded out-of-core cache and phase protocol from evidence.

methodology_transfer_lab.title: Method transfer analysis
methodology_transfer_lab.summary: Computes phase-separated rates and paired ratios from matched cells.

muse_nvfp4_reader.title: Muse NVFP4 reader builder
muse_nvfp4_reader.summary: Extends the converter so the stacked Muse NVFP4 experts and their scale planes become an NVFP4 GGUF pack, bit for bit and lazily.

node_check.title: Node check
node_check.summary: Checks a task graph node's work before it can be done: the capsule's verifier on the exact diff, then an independent reviewer that never sees the building agent's context.

numerical_investigation_lab.title: Logit divergence analysis
numerical_investigation_lab.summary: Compares captured full-vocabulary logits and finds the first divergence.

observability_event_recorder.title: Runtime event recorder builder
observability_event_recorder.summary: Bounded recording of selected experts and scheduler observations without changing inference.

performance_baseline.title: Performance ceiling analysis
performance_baseline.summary: Separates compute and traffic bounds, targets, simulations and measurements.

precision_lab.title: Quantization precision analysis
precision_lab.summary: Evaluates tensor errors against an explicit approximation budget.

quant_kernel_profile.title: Quantized kernel profile analysis
quant_kernel_profile.summary: Inventories quantized matmul and dequantization paths and their share of request time.

request_fault_io_analysis.title: Request fault and I/O analysis
request_fault_io_analysis.summary: Quantifies page faults, file-cache changes and storage reads around the first token.

routing_profile_analysis.title: Expert routing profile analysis
routing_profile_analysis.summary: Ranks experts from routing counts and reports coverage, payload bytes and copy timing.

serving_scheduler_lab.title: Serving scheduler analysis
serving_scheduler_lab.summary: Explores token scheduling, chunked prefill and decode fairness on CPU traces.

source_workbench.title: Source integration workbench
source_workbench.summary: Inspects and edits the task-owned source checkout and records local commits.

capped_runner.title: Capped run workbench
capped_runner.summary: Runs builds, conversions, requantizations, server runs and paired accuracy as capped jobs of the task and records each run.

spark_gap_analysis.title: Engine gap analysis
spark_gap_analysis.summary: Quantifies the TTFT and decode gap between matched arms and the reference engine.

ssd_streaming_lab.title: SSD read schedule analysis
ssd_streaming_lab.summary: Evaluates a modeled positional read schedule for streamed weights.

standard_benchmark.title: Standard benchmark runner
standard_benchmark.summary: Submits a frozen benchmark contract and reads back its results.

strata_prefill_chunk.title: Strata prefill chunk tuner
strata_prefill_chunk.summary: Builds one-variable prefill-chunk candidate profiles for an admitted Strata profile.

strata_prefill_workbench.title: Strata prefill experiment runner
strata_prefill_workbench.summary: Designs, submits and reconciles one scoped Strata prefill experiment.

strata_throughput_workbench.title: Strata throughput experiment runner
strata_throughput_workbench.summary: Investigates Strata throughput with checked profile pairs and admitted experiments.

strata_verified_drafting.title: Strata verified drafting switch
strata_verified_drafting.summary: Creates a candidate profile that only toggles Strata speculative drafting.

weight_pack_compiler.title: Pack compiler
weight_pack_compiler.summary: Chooses bit widths by weight group from a sensitivity census, builds the pack and checks tensor types, preserved scales and size.

weight_placement_planner.title: Weight placement planner builder
weight_placement_planner.summary: Offline byte-budget placement plan and the loader readback that applies it.

paired_accuracy.title: Paired accuracy gate
paired_accuracy.summary: Fixes a seeded MMLU question order and checks a paired reference-vs-candidate accuracy run: identical prompts, planned checkpoints, and the paired interval of the loss against a pinned margin.

prefill_batch_sizing.title: Prefill batch sizing
prefill_batch_sizing.summary: Sizes prefill batches to the target device budget using measured allocation and compute costs.

expert_fill.title: Decode expert fill builder
expert_fill.summary: Reads the router-selected experts' non-resident mmap ranges with parallel preads before the expert matmuls, decode only; off by default (LLAMA_EXPERT_FILL).
